Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in the final comparison of the dates. After correctly identifying that Emma Bull was born in 1954 and Virginia Woolf in 1882, the Planner incorrectly concluded that Emma Bull was born earlier. Since 1882 comes before 1954, Virginia Woolf was actually born earlier. The error occurred in the final step where the Planner synthesized the gathered information and generated the wrong conclusion.
